[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
From ''History of Allegheny County, Pennsylvania'':
<blockquote>
Sarah (wife of Alexander
Glasgow, of Iowa)
</blockquote>

== Research Notes ==
=== Father review, 26 October 2026 ===

The existing father [[Glasgow-209|John Glasgow]] is assessed at '''93%''' for Alexander’s complete father-profile identification, superseding the 22 October 62% probable assessment. This strengthens an existing attachment; it adds no new father.

The family account attributed to [[Glasgow-590|William Melanchthon Glasgow]] explicitly names Alexander among the eight children of John and Peninnah. It identifies him as a farmer who moved to Sharon, Iowa, died in 1857 and left a large family chiefly in Iowa. The writer calls John his paternal grandfather and identifies Moses as his father. The particular household and Iowa death context identify the Alexander represented here.<ref name="WMGlasgowFamily">Melanchthon Glasgow, ''History of the Glasgow Family'', undated six-page typescript, printed pp. 3–4 (PDF pp. 3–4). [https://www.wikitree.com/photo.php/0/0a/Glasgow-590.pdf Scanned family account], visually checked 26 October 2026.</ref>

The account lists '''Alexander and Robert as separate brothers'''. Robert was unmarried and living at Mount Washington, Pittsburgh when the account was written. The additional “Robert” in this profile’s structured name is not established by this source; do not combine the brothers. The retained Cushing citation below independently identifies Sarah as wife of Alexander Glasgow of Iowa.

The 93% is subjective. This is retrospective close-family testimony, not a contemporary birth register or will; minor date discrepancies elsewhere in the account remain. Exact vital dates and other relatives’ assessments are retained.

=== Earlier assessment, 22 October 2026 — superseded ===


This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-209]] is assessed at 62% (probable). Robert Alexander’s exact 1807 birth fits John’s 1780 generation and the established Adams County descendant family. The inherited attachment supplies a particular father within that family, but Robert’s retained county-history citation concerns his wife Sarah’s later family and does not independently name his father.

Probable 62%; specific compiled pedigree and compatible chronology, without a held parent clause.

Next useful test: Read Robert’s entry in the Faris descendant genealogy.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-997 WikiTree profile export for Glasgow-997]. No new original inspected; no new father attached.
